name: name
description: Registered icon name (e.g. 'academic-cap') or CSS font icon class string (e.g. 'fa-solid fa-house').

name: variant
description: Heroicons style variant used to resolve the SVG glyph.

name: class
description: Extra CSS utility classes merged onto the host or icon element.

name: icon
description: Direct icon definition (FontAwesomeIconDefinition, CustomIconData, SVG string, or font class string).

name: fontIcon
description: Direct CSS font icon class string for CDN-based webfonts (e.g. 'fa-solid fa-coffee', 'pi pi-check').

name: ariaLabel
description: Accessible label for the icon. When omitted, the icon is marked decorative with aria-hidden='true'.
